// A ball that moves between two places on a Spring: it says where
// the ball belongs, and finds the way there.

App [

    lane: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, height = 60,

        ball: View [ y = center, width = 60, height = 60,
            cornerRadius = 30, fill = dodgerblue,
            Spring [ attribute = x, to = { right ? lane.width - ball.width : 0 },
                stiffness = 190, damping = 20 ]
            ]
        ],

    hint: Text [ x = center, y = 28, textColor = slategray,
        text = "click anywhere to move the ball" ],

    right: boolean = false,

    onClick() { right = !right }
    ]
